title: Magical Drop III: Toretate Zoukangou!
native_title: マジカル・ドロップⅢ ～とれたて増刊号！～
overview:
Once a year, Magical Land holds a tournament, and the winner receives the legendary Magical Drop, said to make dreams come true. A large cast of characters enters to claim it.

Magical Drop III is a fast-paced action puzzle game. Rows of colored drops push down from the top of the field while your jester runs along the bottom, pulling drops out and throwing them back up to line up three or more of the same color. Cleared drops let the ones above shift, setting off chain reactions that send uneven rows onto your opponent's side. Push in extra rows yourself to set up bigger combos, and win by overflowing your rival's field or clearing your quota of drops first.

- Story Mode: face a series of opponents with conversations between matches
- Versus Mode: two-player battles with custom rules and handicaps
- Endless Mode: clear level after level on a wider field
- Sugoroku Mode: a board game for one or two players, rolling dice and taking on challenges to collect medals before facing the final boss
